title: Single sign-on for the admin console
description: Enterprise customers keep asking for SAML/OIDC login on the admin console. It unblocks several large deals and is a fairly contained change.

title: Real-time collaboration on documents
description: Let multiple users edit the same document at once with live cursors. High demand from our top accounts; the sync layer is a moderate effort.

title: Rewrite the billing engine
description: Replace the legacy billing engine with a metered, usage-based system. Very valuable but a large multi-quarter undertaking touching many services.

title: Localized number and date formatting
description: Format numbers, currencies, and dates according to the user's locale. Nice for international users but requires a sweeping change across every view.

title: Keyboard shortcuts for common actions
description: Add keyboard shortcuts for navigation and the most common actions. Solid quality-of-life win that a single engineer can ship quickly.

title: Dark mode theme
description: Offer an optional dark theme. Frequently requested cosmetic enhancement; moderate amount of CSS work.

title: Redesign the empty-state illustrations
description: Refresh the empty-state illustrations across the app. Purely cosmetic polish that would take a good chunk of design and engineering time.
